tickerText: [TENNIS] US Open qual Round 2 — Jordan Lee (16) chases main draw; Glasspool/Routliffe face Alcaraz/Williams in mixed doubles • [SQUASH] Budapest Open quarter-finals today — Takacs & Farkas hunt Copper crown after dramatic five-game wins • [BADMINTON] Aaron Chia–Soh Wooi Yik weigh future after Worlds silver; Soh axed from Asian Games squad • [PICKLEBALL] Veolia Nationals Cary Aug 31; Hong Kong Slam offers record $1.1M prize Oct 19–25 • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Macao Sep 8–13 at East Asian Games Dome; 1,000 ranking points on line

newsItems.title: US Open Qualifying & Mixed Doubles Blockbuster
newsItems.excerpt: Lloyd Glasspool and Erin Routliffe will face Carlos Alcaraz and Serena Williams in mixed doubles while round two of US Open singles qualifying continues at Flushing Meadows today.

newsItems.title: Budapest Open Quarter-Finals
newsItems.excerpt: The PSA Budapest Open reaches quarter-final day, with home hopes Benedek Takacs and Balazs Farkas still alive after dramatic five-game wins on opening day at the Copper event.

newsItems.title: Hong Kong Slam Sets $1.1M Record
newsItems.excerpt: The Hang Seng Bank Hong Kong Slam — Asia's first PPA Slam — will offer a record $1.1 million prize purse Oct 19–25 at Kai Tak Sports Park, with 860+ players expected.

newsItems.title: WTT Champions Macao Returns
newsItems.excerpt: WTT Champions Macao runs Sep 8–13 at the East Asian Games Dome, drawing 32 men's and women's singles players with 1,000 ranking points for the champions.
